name: GIFT-Eval
description: GIFT-Eval is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating general time series forecasting models across diverse datasets, domains, and forecasting horizons. It includes 23 datasets with over 144,000 time series and provides a large non-leaking pretraining dataset to facilitate foundation model development and evaluation.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by dataset and metric; unknown
reputation: A recent benchmark from the time-series forecasting literature that is gaining attention for broad, leakage-aware evaluation across many datasets and horizons.
notes: Includes 23 datasets spanning 7 domains and 10 frequencies; provides leaderboard and extensive baseline analysis.
